Now it clicks: the transformation is (r-1, c-1)*2, meaning only cells with both odd row and column coordinates survive, since those correspond to indices in an underlying 5x5 grid that gets scaled up to 20x20 with 4x4 blocks. That explains why cells at even coordinates in my test grid get discarded while the single odd-odd cell carries through.
